subject: Operational Resilience Packet — Recovery Window Artifacts & Witness Plan
messages:
From: Evan Park <audit@brightcompliance.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@atlasbank.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operational Resilience Packet — Recovery Window Artifacts & Witness Plan

Hi Lukas,

Following Atlas Bank's SIG review, we need a compact Operational Resilience packet from Redwood to validate the RTO/RPO commitments tied to the account. Specifically we are requesting the following artifacts and scheduling a short remote witness session: 

- A CSV heatmap of observed recovery windows and measured RTO/RPO across services for the last 6 months (aggregate by service and by incident).
- Warm-start trace logs for your multi-region warm failover (sample traces for the most recent warm-start test).
- The current DR runbook (latest published) with the roles and playbook steps annotated.
- A short (15–20 slide) executive summary explaining your warm-start process and any automatic KV cache rehydration steps.

Can you confirm: do you prefer we receive raw traces and let us sampl e them, or a redacted/sanitized bundle? Also confirm whether 6 months is sufficient or if you prefer a rolling 12-month set.

For the witness session, our auditors are available the week of Nov 1. Please propose 2x 90-minute windows where your ops team can walk us through one warm-start and answer follow-ups.

Please send the artifacts to audit@brightcompliance.com or share via a secure link (Doc/Drive) and include any access instructions.

Thanks,

Evan Park
Senior Auditor, Bright Compliance
Audit Team


--
Bright Compliance
audit@brightcompliance.com
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <audit@brightcompliance.com>
Cc: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@atlasbank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational Resilience Packet — Recovery Window Artifacts & Witness Plan

Hi Evan,

Thanks — we can produce the package. Quick answers up front: 6 months will be fine for the primary artifacts, but we can provide a rolling 12-month summary if Atlas would like historical context. For traces, we prefer to provide a sanitized bundle (redacting any account identifiers) and include a small set of raw traces under an NDA if needed.

Planned artifacts: runbook_v2.pdf (annotated), rto_rpo_heatmap_2026Q3.csv (service-level aggregate), warm_start_traces_10-08.zip (sanitized sample traces), and a short slide deck (ops_warmstart_overview.pdf). Vanessa will attach the files and the secure Drive links.

For witness windows we can offer: 
- Nov 3, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Nov 4, 13:00–14:30 PT

If those don't work, we can expand to Nov 1–5 and include an early-morning slot for EU overlaps.

Vanessa / Marcus — tagging you for the artifacts and any notes to include in the executive summary (automated cache rehydration steps, expected timeouts, and rollback triggers).

Best,

Lukas Meyer
Head of SRE, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <audit@brightcompliance.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@atlasbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational Resilience Packet — Recovery Window Artifacts & Witness Plan

Hi Evan / team,

Attached are the sanitized artifacts we discussed. Attachment list (also uploaded to a restricted Drive link):
- runbook_v2.pdf (annotated with owner contact, step numbers, and time-to-complete estimates)
- rto_rpo_heatmap_2026Q3.csv (columns: service, incident_id, observed_rto_seconds, observed_rpo_seconds, region, timestamp)
- warm_start_traces_10-08.zip (sample traces from the Oct 8 tabletop, PII redacted)

Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/ops/runbook_v2 (shared with expiry 14 days)
Notes: 
- Warm-start process: our private deployment path includes an automated KV cache checkpoint + async rehydrate to regional node pools; typical cache rehydration completes within 60–180 seconds depending on keyspace. We include a short replay trace (warm_start_traces_10-08/trace_01.log) demonstrating request fanout and cache warm-up metrics.
- Evidence selection: we chose representative incidents and anonymized incident IDs; we can provide additional raw logs under an MSA/NDA if Atlas legal requires it.

I've also included a short ops memo (ops_warmstart_overview.pdf) with timing expectations and a runbook excerpt. Marcus — see highlighted section on fallback to degraded-mode routing (page 7).

Let me know if you want the artifacts packaged differently.

Regards,

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Production Ops
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Evan Park <audit@brightcompliance.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@atlasbank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational Resilience Packet — Recovery Window Artifacts & Witness Plan

Lukas / Vanessa,

Received — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the Drive link. We reviewed the file list and the heatmap format looks good for our sampling. For the witness session, Nov 3 10:00–11:30 PT works for our auditors and Atlas stakeholders. We'll plan for a 90-minute session: 30 minutes for the runbook/walkthrough, 30 minutes for the warm-start live walkthrough or replay, and 30 minutes for Q&A.

Please confirm dial-in details and any run-of-show you prefer. Also confirm whether someone from engineering (Marcus) will be available for the replay questions.

I'll send a calendar invite to block the slot and include a short agenda.

Best,

Evan Park
Senior Auditor, Bright Compliance
